channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jonathan Isaac | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jonathan Isaac from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
Magic’s Jeff Weltman:

“Our thoughts are with Jonathan, whose fortitude in dealing with adversity is unique. Jonathan has worked extremely hard to return to the court this season and has demonstrated his impact on our team. We will be by his side as he focuses on the work ahead.”

Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac, Mar 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: Ted Cruz on Kyrie Irving, Bradley Beal, Andrew Wiggins, Jonathan Isaac
item.description:

“I stand with Kyrie Irving. I stand with Andrew Wiggins. I stand with Bradley Beal. I stand with Jonathan Isaac,”

Ted Cruz on Kyrie Irving, Bradley Beal, Andrew Wiggins, Jonathan Isaac, Sep 29, 2021. Source: The Hill.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
Keith Smith:Aaron Gordon on feeling additional pressure as a defender with Jonathan Isaac out:

“I do, but I pride myself on being a two-way player. I want to defend to the other team's best player. But it's not about just one-on-one, it's about us defending as a five man unit.”

Aaron Gordon on Jonathan Isaac, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
Aaron Gordon on the Magic game broadcast about Jonathan Isaac:

“My whole heart goes out to him. He's such a great guy, such a great person. ... I hope it's nothing serious. I hope it's just something that kind of shocked him. But it was sad, man. It brought tears to my eyes.”

Aaron Gordon on Jonathan Isaac, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
Weltman made it crystal clear that Isaac is highly unlikely to play in either the eight regular-season games or during the postseason.

“I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again: We’re planning on life without Jonathan,”

Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac, Jul 8, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
More @Orlando Magic GEvan Fournier on Jonathan Isaac:

“His shot-making, especially the corner 3s, is going to be key for him. Especially as a young player, that’s what you have to do – knock down open shots to be dangerous. Us players and the coaches are really high on him.”

Evan Fournier on Jonathan Isaac, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac
item.description:
Reunited in Orlando, Weltman and Hammond have used their first two lottery picks on Isaac and Bamba, essentially throwing a challenge flag for the duration of this rebuild to the concept that the best teams can only be effective with one nimble, rim-protecting center on the floor at any given time.

“Everyone is looking for switchable defenders and versatile types of players, and we just believe that Mo and Jonathan have that component,”

Jeff Weltman on Jonathan Isaac, Jul 13, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
